signature: An endless library inside the Terror Hotel: checkered-marble corridors between walls of dusty books under Renaissance paintings and 'Promethei Bibliotheca' in gilt, tuff pillars, and a void fenced with iron bars where wooden stairs climb all seven floors; it takes your memories and shelves them as notebooks.

exits.label: Opened the small wooden door at a dead end and came out at the library's entrance
exits.method: wooden door at a dead-end corridor
exits.source_quote: a chance that a corridor will lead to a dead end with a wooden door
exits.hint: Some corridors stop at a marble wall. Look for a candle burning at the end of one.

exits.label: Went back out through the old wooden door into the hotel corridor (not explicitly stated on the page)
exits.hint: The door you came in by is still behind you.

fail_states.label: Fell into the void below the seventh floor
fail_states.source_quote: near the side of the corridor connecting to a void

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: the Library Mind is bodiless and never shown (captions, falling books, a collapsing bookcase, headaches). The Gentleman appears only as evidence of his visit (a flung notebook of staff sketches). No wandering entities (testimony: none seen).
notes: SOURCE: sub-section of the Terror Hotel discovered May 2016; only known entrance an old wooden door at the end of a newly found corridor of peeled, old wallpaper near the M.E.G. base Housekeeping (unreliable); elegant library, hundreds of corridors on all sides; marble walls with granite features; tuff pillars; iron bars along the side of the corridor that meets a void; Renaissance-style paintings above the bookshelves; infinitely long corridors but only seven floors, linked by wooden staircases; the name at the top of some walls; books of any colour and size, rare gilded illuminations, pristine but dusty; mostly unknown languages, some English, French, Italian; topics mainly the Backrooms (Hoofstaad, Ambassadors, the Macchina named); memory extraction after one to two hours (newer or important memories), growing headaches, unnoticed without outside help; memories consigned to books (notebook to series); do not stay over an hour; the Library Mind trades knowledge for memory, refuses those who would harm or dominate (headaches, heavy loss), talks through emotions, drops books to guide, collapses bookshelves in anger; animosity to the hotel staff (documents imply the staff isolated it); the Lost Hall Society (peaceful collectors and historians) used it until about the 17th century; no entities seen (testimony); a corridor may end in a dead end with a wooden door that leads back to the entrance; the Gentleman's visit (vignette). ADAPTATION: finite streaming window of 24 m chunks with all seven floors (5 m storeys, arrival on floor 4); the corridor grid, shelf walls and ranges, bay reading tables and the void-block frequency (~1 in 5) are ours; switchback wooden stairs in each void; dead ends seeded at 10% per block and storey, one always next to the arrival on floor 4; the loop door is a seamless return to the entrance (no reload) so the memory state persists; L005_3>L005#2 is realised as the old door you arrived through (page: the Gentleman 'left the Promethean Library'; no explicit exit); time compression: one hour is about six minutes, extraction seeded between 6 and 12 minutes; the lectern's three requests, the margin-translated Lost Hall book and the Hermes-team card are framing devices for paraphrased page facts; consigned notebooks list your most recent levels and what you read; a fall below floor 1 is fatal (ADAPTATION). QA: the bot walks to the old door behind the arrival.
